name: Retrieval for Mauren
summary: In Stormwind, Collin Mauren asks travelers bound for Kalimdor to bring him rare basilisk scales. He wants scales from the Charred Vale in Stonetalon to grind into dust for his spellcraft.

sections.title: A Mage's Curious Reagents
sections.body: Collin Mauren, a wizard in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, listens to tales from wandering adventurers. He has heard that travelers are venturing deep into Kalimdor, where Stonetalon draws those seeking wild wyverns, unruly elementals, or deals and clashes with the Venture Company. Mauren is not after riches or glory. He wants to learn what rare natural wonders survive in the region's harshest corners.

sections.title: The Glassy Beasts of the Vale
sections.body: The Charred Vale lies deep in Stonetalon, an ash-choked basin scarred by the Venture Company's devastation. Mauren's studies say a peculiar breed of basilisk once lived there. Their scales, crushed to a fine powder, can catalyze specialized arcane spells he has developed. He does not know whether the basilisks survived the Vale's harsh transformation, so he asks explorers to bring back fresh crystallised scales and learn whether the breed endures.

faq.answer: Collin Mauren is a wizard in Stormwind's Mage Quarter who studies arcane spellcraft and seeks rare reagents from distant lands.

faq.q: Why does Collin Mauren need basilisk scales?
faq.answer: Mauren grinds crystallised basilisk scales into fine dust to use as a catalyst for spells he has devised.

faq.q: Where is the Charred Vale located?
faq.answer: The Charred Vale is a ruined basin in southwestern Stonetalon Mountains, on Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why is the Charred Vale charred?
faq.answer: The Venture Company's goblins devastated the Charred Vale. Their destruction enraged the vale's spirits and loosed elementals, leaving the ground blackened and smoldering, with hardy, twisted beasts roaming it.

faq.q: What creatures drop the scales needed for this task?
faq.answer: Basilisks in the Charred Vale of Stonetalon Mountains have the scales Mauren seeks.

faq.q: Why send an adventurer all the way across the sea for this?
faq.answer: Mauren needs the crystalline properties found on basilisks native to the Charred Vale. Crossing the Great Sea is perilous, so he asks seasoned travelers already bound for Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a mage, you know that gathering rare reagents for other wizards supports arcane research. Exotic magical wildlife can provide what is needed to develop new incantations.
As an Alliance traveler, you see Stormwind's interests and supply lines reaching deep into Kalimdor's wild territories.
